snippet.title: Star Wrath — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
💥https://starwrath.com/ — your space adventures begin here!
💥https://starwrath.info/starwrathpacks

In Star Wrath, players build and customize their own modular spacecraft, head out on high-risk raids, battle in PvE and PvP encounters, and fight to escape with whatever loot they can carry. Every expedition is a gamble: hide in the deadly nebulae, ambush unsuspecting rivals, and survive intense dogfights powered by realistic physics and an advanced damage system. Every part of the ship — from outer hulls to internal modules — can be destroyed, affecting performance and survivability in real time.

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617990/Star_Wrath
